nodes.description: Load a JSON file from disk and expose it as an artifact_ref.

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Absolute or repo-relative path to a JSON file.

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: ArtifactRef pointing at the loaded JSON payload (copied into run output dir).

nodes.description: Validate a Proposal JSON against proposal.v0.1 using tools/content_pipeline/validate_proposal.validate.

inputs.name: proposal
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a proposal JSON.

nodes.description: Deterministic mock compile of a Proposal into a CompiledAssetCandidate. Does not call a real LLM.

Call an LLM provider to generate a CompiledAssetCandidate v0.1 from a Proposal. Requires params.allow_live_provider_call=true and workflow mode=live. Validates the candidate with validate_asset_candidate before writing. Output artifact kind is compiled_asset_candidate.

inputs.name: proposal
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a Proposal JSON.

inputs.name: registry
inputs.description: Optional ArtifactRef to an effect_blocks registry. Defaults to shared/module_registry/effect_blocks.v0.1.json.

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: ArtifactRef to a validated CompiledAssetCandidate JSON.

nodes.description: Validate a CompiledAssetCandidate against effect_blocks registry using validate_asset_candidate.validate.

inputs.name: registry
inputs.description: Defaults to shared/module_registry/effect_blocks.v0.1.json.

nodes.description: Run a deterministic mock simulation of a CompiledAssetCandidate using simulate_asset_candidate.simulate.
Score a CompiledAssetCandidate using validation, simulation, world-fit, media readiness, and risk guardrails. Produces candidate_score.v0.1.
Deterministic delivery policy: decide whether a compiled asset is runtime_ready, fallback_ready, preview_only, or failed. Gameplay core may be playable even when generated media falls back.
Aggregate upstream artifacts into a pipeline_summary.json (status, paths, balance_flags).
Build a stub RuntimePackage from upstream locked_manifest + first_battle_config. Output is runtime_public-eligible but must not carry raw_media or provider URLs.
Build a research delivery payload stub from locked_manifest + first_battle_config. Carries sample trap metadata with delivery_state; never exposes provider/trace.
Publish a stub media manifest from raw_media stub metadata. Enforces raw_media -> processed_media -> published_media layering. Output published_media may be runtime_public; raw/processed may not.

Deterministic mock of NPC feedback after a battle. Reads battle_result + session_context and produces world-in-language NPC reactions. Does not call a real LLM. Output is narrative-only; no provider/schema/prompt/trace terms.

inputs.name: battle_result
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a battle_result JSON fixture.

inputs.name: session_context
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a session_context JSON fixture.

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: ArtifactRef to a narrative artifact JSON (npc_feedback[], battle_summary, world_events[]).

nodes.description: Deterministic mock of post-battle world growth events. Reads battle_result + session_context and produces world-in-language world state change events. Does not call a real LLM. Output is narrative-only; no provider/schema/prompt/trace terms.

inputs.name: battle_result
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a battle_result JSON fixture.

inputs.name: session_context
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a session_context JSON fixture.

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: ArtifactRef to a narrative artifact JSON (npc_feedback[], battle_summary, world_events[]).

nodes.description: Call an image provider to generate media images for a CompiledAssetCandidate. Requires params.allow_live_provider_call=true and workflow mode=live. Supports roles auto/icon/tower_sprite/ui_card/effect_preview/battle_preview/repair_failed, downloads to local paths, and writes a raw_media_sequence.v0.1 metadata artifact (media_layer=raw_media). Optional repair_plan input appends deterministic prompt repair constraints. Output must flow through the media processing chain before becoming runtime_public.

inputs.name: candidate
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a CompiledAssetCandidate JSON.

inputs.name: repair_plan
inputs.description: Optional ArtifactRef to a MediaPromptRepairPlan JSON. Required when params.roles='repair_failed'.

nodes.description: Build a deterministic VisualIdentitySpec from a CompiledAssetCandidate. The spec fixes subject, silhouette, materials, palette, required motifs, forbidden elements, and role directives before media generation or review.

inputs.name: candidate
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a CompiledAssetCandidate JSON.

nodes.description: Check media metadata and local file headers when available. Reports role coverage, dimensions, format/extension mismatch, fallback use, and required visual/OCR review flags.
Check role coverage, provider/model/style consistency, dimensions, stable IDs, and VisualIdentitySpec linkage. Produces a MediaConsistencyReport.

Call a vision model to review local generated images for OCR/text, watermark, same-subject consistency, world fit, and role fit. Produces a MediaVisionReviewReport and never writes raw prompts or raw provider responses.

Build a deterministic MediaPromptRepairPlan from quality, consistency, and vision review reports. The plan identifies failed roles, reusable roles, negative constraints, and role-specific prompt suffixes for a repair generation pass.
Merge original raw media with regenerated repair media by media_role. Reuses passed roles, replaces target_roles from MediaPromptRepairPlan, and outputs a complete raw_media_sequence for re-review.

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: ArtifactRef to a merged raw_media_sequence.v0.1 JSON.

nodes.description: PNG v0.1 processor: remove pure/near-pure matte background from raw_media PNG items, write transparent PNG files, and promote media_layer raw_media -> processed_media. Node name is kept for workflow compatibility.

inputs.name: media_metadata
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a media metadata JSON (media_layer=raw_media).

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: ArtifactRef to a media metadata JSON (media_layer=processed_media).

nodes.description: PNG v0.1 processor: crop processed_media PNG items to alpha bounds, add padding, write updated PNG files, and keep media_layer=processed_media. Node name is kept for workflow compatibility.

inputs.name: media_metadata
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a media metadata JSON (media_layer=processed_media).

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: ArtifactRef to a media metadata JSON (media_layer=processed_media).

nodes.description: PNG v0.1 processor: normalize processed_media PNG item canvas dimensions, optionally square-pad and bottom-align sprites. media_layer stays processed_media. Node name is kept for workflow compatibility.

inputs.name: media_metadata
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a media metadata JSON (media_layer=processed_media).

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: ArtifactRef to a media metadata JSON (media_layer=processed_media).

nodes.description: PNG v0.1 metadata processor: assign anchor points to processed_media items. Sprites default to bottom_center; UI/preview media default to center. media_layer stays processed_media.

inputs.name: media_metadata
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a media metadata JSON (media_layer=processed_media).

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: ArtifactRef to a media metadata JSON (media_layer=processed_media).

nodes.description: PNG v0.1 processor: pack processed_media PNG items into a horizontal atlas PNG plus JSON descriptor, and attach atlas frames to item metadata. media_layer stays processed_media.

inputs.name: media_metadata
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a media metadata JSON (media_layer=processed_media).

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: ArtifactRef to a media metadata JSON (media_layer=processed_media).

nodes.description: PNG v0.1 publisher: copy processed PNG items and atlas files into a published directory, write hashes, anchors, atlas frames, and local /assets/generated paths. Promotes processed_media -> published_media. Output is runtime_public-eligible.

inputs.name: media_metadata
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a media metadata JSON (media_layer=processed_media).

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: ArtifactRef to a published_media manifest JSON (media_layer=published_media).

nodes.description: Deterministic runtime media gate: check published PNG files, /assets paths, sha256, alpha coverage, subject bounds, anchors, texture keys, and atlas frames before media is considered game-loadable.

inputs.name: published_media
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a published_media_manifest JSON produced by media.build_atlas_json_stub.

nodes.description: Deterministic mock: build a WorldStateDelta from battle_result + session_context + narrative artifacts (npc_feedback, world_growth). Validates the delta before writing. Does not call a real LLM. Output is a world_state_delta.v0.1 JSON artifact with no provider/model/raw_prompt/trace terms.

inputs.name: run_world_state
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a RunWorldState JSON.

inputs.name: battle_result
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a battle_result JSON.

inputs.name: session_context
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a session_context JSON.

inputs.name: npc_feedback
inputs.description: Optional ArtifactRef to a narrative npc_feedback artifact.

inputs.name: world_growth
inputs.description: Optional ArtifactRef to a narrative world_growth artifact.

nodes.description: Deterministic: apply a validated WorldStateDelta to a RunWorldState. Delegates to apply_world_delta.apply_delta and validates both input and output state. Raises NodeError on failure. Does not call a real LLM. Output is a next RunWorldState JSON artifact.

inputs.name: run_world_state
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a RunWorldState JSON.

inputs.name: world_state_delta
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a WorldStateDelta JSON.

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: ArtifactRef to the next RunWorldState JSON.

nodes.description: Call an LLM provider to generate a WorldStateDelta v0.1. Requires params.allow_live_provider_call=true and workflow mode=live. Validates the delta with jsonschema + world delta rules before writing. Output artifact is a world_state_delta with no provider/model/raw_prompt terms.

inputs.name: run_world_state
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a RunWorldState JSON.

inputs.name: battle_result
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a battle_result JSON.

inputs.name: session_context
inputs.description: ArtifactRef to a session_context JSON.

outputs.name: default
outputs.description: ArtifactRef to a validated WorldStateDelta v0.1 JSON.
